name: global-clock-rings
prompt: Concentric rings pulsing outward. The pulse should stay in sync with the composition clock even if the layer starts later, but the fade-in should start when the layer starts.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer with concentric rings that pulse outward. The pulse follows the composition clock (iGlobalTime), so it stays in sync even if the layer starts later. The fade-in follows the layer's own clock (iTime), so it starts when the layer starts and lasts uFadeIn seconds (default 1s). There are controls for speed, density, ring width, fade length and both colors. I didn't compile or render it because no live Powermove tools were attached to this run.
